[[File:Gold_spacecraft-Shiny_as_a_Droid.jpg|250px|thumb|C-3PO and R2-D2 inspect the spacecraft]]
This '''gold spacecraft''' was a vessel used by [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on a trip to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after being stranded on another planet. The wedge-shaped ship featured an socket for an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] and a single pilot's seat. The craft's engine required [[space crystal]]s to function. When stranded, the droids needed to retrieve new space crystals from a cave when the ship's supply had been depleted.<ref name="Shiny">''[[Shiny as a Droid: Things to See, Touch, and Smell from a Galaxy Far, Far Away]]''</ref>
